title: Ma Rainey in Chicago, her gold pieces and young lovers
summary: She knew Ma Rainey, saw her robbed of her gold-piece necklace at her brother's house, and says Ma took young lovers.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
